# Fixture: house_created_push.json

Cross-language test fixture for the `house_created` APNs push payload
(contract: `specs/005-soyeht-onboarding/contracts/push-events.md`).

## Contents

`../house_created_push.json` — array of 5 `{ input, expected }` pairs.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `input.hh_id` | Household ID — `"hh_"` prefix + 52-char lowercase base32 |
| `input.hh_name` | Human-readable household name (UTF-8, ≤64 bytes) |
| `input.machine_id` | Machine ID — `"m_"` prefix + 52-char lowercase base32 |
| `input.machine_label` | Human-readable machine label (UTF-8, ≤32 bytes) |
| `input.pair_qr_uri` | Fallback pairing URI |
| `input.ts` | Unix epoch seconds |
| `expected.aps` | Full APNs envelope — `aps` dictionary per Apple spec |
| `expected.soyeht` | Custom `soyeht` payload section |

The `expected` object is a deterministic function of the `input` fields:
no additional randomness is involved in building the APNs envelope.

## Derivation

Inputs are generated by `generate.py` using:

```
SHA-256(SEED || domain_utf8 || index_byte)
```

where:
- `SEED = b"soyeht-onboarding-house-created-fixture-2026"` (44 bytes)
- `domain` distinguishes field type: `"hh_id"`, `"m_id"`, `"anchor"`
- `index_byte` is `0x00` – `0x04` for entries 0–4

The 32-byte digest is base32-encoded (lowercase, RFC 4648, no padding) to
produce the ID body. SHA-256 is used instead of a PRNG so the derivation is
byte-identical in Python, Rust, Swift, or any other language without
requiring external random-number libraries.

## Regenerating

From the repo root:

```sh
uv run python admin/rust/server-rs/tests/fixtures/house_created_push/generate.py \
  > admin/rust/server-rs/tests/fixtures/house_created_push.json
```

Regenerate whenever:
- The `house_created` APNs payload contract shape changes (`push-events.md`).
- Additional fixture entries are needed (increment the `range(5)` call).

After regenerating, re-run:
- Rust: `cargo test -p server-rs house_created_push`
- Swift (iSoyehtTerm): `HouseCreatedPushPayloadTests` — verifies byte-equal
  JSON generation and parsing against this fixture.

## Cross-language use

iSoyehtTerm consumes this fixture via a build-phase script that copies
`house_created_push.json` into the test bundle before running
`HouseCreatedPushPayloadTests.swift` (front-end task T067b). Any divergence
between Rust and Swift payload construction fails CI on both sides.
